'''''Jedi Trial''''' is a novel written by [[David Sherman]] and [[Dan Cragg]]. It was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[October 26]], [[2004]] in hardback. The first paperback edition was released on [[May 31]], [[2005]]. ''Jedi Trial'' is the story of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Nejaa Halcyon]] and their fight to free a crucial communications hub from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. ''Jedi Trial'' also includes a preview of the novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]. Narration for the audio version was performed by [[Jonathan Davis]]. The book is part of the [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].
